summary: Iteration 8 — Verified (a) 'Nama Pengirim' (from_name) field on Kelola Notifikasi saves & persists after reload, (b) channel switches (email/telegram/browser) toggle & save via PUT /api/settings, (c) ATTACHMENT REGRESSION on preview (Emergent Object Storage path) is intact — POST/GET/DELETE /api/attachments all return 200 for both DocumentManager (task) and AttachmentPanel (meeting) flows in the UI, (d) Reminders page shows Email + WhatsApp channel buttons only (Telegram button removed) and POST /api/reminders with channels=['whatsapp'] returns 200, (e) creating a task with a PIC that has an email returns 200 even with email channel disabled (dispatch_email short-circuits, no crash). Backend 14/14 iter8 tests pass; full regression 108/109 pass — the 1 failure is a self-inflicted test-parallelism race in TestSettingsFromName.test_toggle_channels_saves (two workers editing the same settings doc), NOT a product bug; the test passes when run in isolation.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Same warning appears on other dialogs. Low priority a11y hint.

action_items: Optional (test hygiene, not product bug): make TestSettingsFromName.test_toggle_channels_saves resilient to parallel runs OR mark serial — it collides with test_email_channel_remains_disabled when pytest-xdist splits classes across workers.
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Reminders dialog and NotificationSettings dialogs.

Doc discrepancy: request said 'upload attachment via attachment panel (data-testid=attachment-input)' on task detail, but tasks actually use DocumentManager (data-testid task-doc-file-input / task-doc-add-file); attachment-input only exists on MeetingDetail. Both hit the same /api/attachments endpoint so the regression is covered, but consider aligning naming.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications._send_email swallows ALL SMTP exceptions silently (bare try/except pass). Combined with dispatch_email returning True even on send failure means callers cannot distinguish 'kanal disabled' from 'SMTP error'. Consider logging the exception and returning a status enum.

storage._use_local uses process-import-time snapshot of EMERGENT_LLM_KEY / LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR (module-level constants). If ops rotates or sets these vars after uvicorn is running, storage.py won't notice until restart. Fine for now but worth a docstring.

server._dispatch_reminders (WhatsApp branch) creates an in-app notification with a wa.me link but never marks the reminder as delivered by any WhatsApp confirmation — it just relies on broadcast_sent=True. If the user never opens the wa.me link, nothing happens. That is by design (link approach) but not obvious; consider surfacing 'Waiting to be sent by you' state in the UI.

routers/attachments.py wraps put_object errors in HTTPException 502 but leaks the raw exception message in `detail`. For Emergent storage failures with a signed URL/token snippet this could leak sensitive info in error toasts. Consider a generic message + server-side log.

success_rate.backend: 100% in isolation (14/14 iter8); 108/109 full regression (1 self-test race)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (from_name persist, channel toggles, WhatsApp reminder create, task DocumentManager upload, meeting AttachmentPanel upload+delete)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created & self-cleaned TEST_iter8_* tasks and reminders. UI test created 1 meeting attachment (deleted via UI), and 1 extra task doc entry on the first task in list; from_name field reset to '' after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On preview EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is present (backend/.env line 7) so storage._use_local()==False; the Emergent object storage path is exercised for POST/GET/DELETE /api/attachments and returned 200 in both backend and UI runs. Tasks use DocumentManager (data-testid task-doc-file-input / task-doc-add-file / task-doc-<id> / task-doc-del-<id>) NOT AttachmentPanel; only MeetingDetail mounts AttachmentPanel (data-testid attachment-input / btn-upload-attachment / btn-delete-attachment-<id>). Both hit /api/attachments (module=task vs module=meeting). Reminders channel buttons: data-testid reminder-channel-email and reminder-channel-whatsapp (no telegram). from_name field: data-testid setting-from-name in NotificationSettings.jsx.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested features verified working.
